import sys, os, time, hashlib
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
for k in ['OPENROUTER_API_KEY', 'PLACE_MODEL']: os.environ.pop(k, None)
from types import ModuleType
from collections import Counter
from itertools import product
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
sys.path.insert(0, '/root/worktrees/send-c1b/backend')
from dealroom_sign import placement as _p
from dealroom_sign.tests.test_placement_r14 import in_process
from dealroom_sign.tests import placement_r24_review_cases as R24
from dealroom_sign.tests.test_placement import TWO
rc = R24.rc
live = open('/root/worktrees/send-merge/backend/dealroom_sign/placement.py').read()
assert hashlib.sha256(live.encode()).hexdigest().startswith('f26d989f')
SRC = dict(r27=live, r28=open(_p.__file__).read())
assert hashlib.sha256(SRC['r28'].encode()).hexdigest().startswith('e5dc8ef0')
def mk(n):
    m = ModuleType('rev28q3_'+n); m.__file__ = _p.__file__; sys.modules[m.__name__] = m
    exec(compile(SRC[n], m.__name__, 'exec'), m.__dict__); return m
M = dict((n, mk(n)) for n in SRC)
http = Mock(side_effect=AssertionError('http')); calls = Counter()
def run(pages, people, allowed):
    pdf = rc.pages_pdf(pages); out = ''
    for n, m in M.items():
        mo = Mock(); r = in_process(m, pdf, people, mo); calls[n] += mo.call_count
        out += 'W' if rc.wrong_fields(r, allowed) else ('p' if r['fields'] else 'n')
    return out
CAPS = [None, 'Attention:', 'Witness:', 'Employee Name:', 'cc:', 'Approved by:', 'Signature:']
HEAD = {None: 'NOTICES:', 'Attention:': 'NOTICES:', 'cc:': 'NOTICES:', 'Witness:': 'WITNESS:'}
NAMES = ['Chris Jones', 'Attention: Chris Jones', 'Pat Smith', 'Attention: Pat Smith', 'cc: Lee Harbor', 'Nom: Chris Jones', 'Lee Harbor, General Counsel']
TAILS = ['none', 'title_text', 'title_rule', 'its_rule', 'email_rule', 'date_rule']
def struct(cap, nm, tail, x, y):
    rows = [(y - 30, HEAD.get(cap, 'EXHIBIT B - FORM'), False, x), (y, cap or '', True, x, x + 180), (y + 12, nm, False, x)]
    if tail == 'title_text': rows.append((y + 24, 'Title: General Counsel', False, x))
    elif tail == 'title_rule': rows.append((y + 40, 'Title:', True, x, x + 180))
    elif tail == 'its_rule': rows.append((y + 40, 'Its:', True, x, x + 180))
    elif tail == 'email_rule': rows.append((y + 40, 'Email:', True, x, x + 180))
    elif tail == 'date_rule': rows.append((y + 50, 'Date:', True, x, x + 180))
    return rows
WHERE = sys.argv[1:]
G = Counter(); EX = Counter(); t = time.time()
with patch('httpx.Client.send', http):
    for where, cap, nm, tail, recital, signer, msa in product(WHERE, CAPS, NAMES, TAILS, ('none', 'parsed'), ('domain', 'explicit', 'both'), (False, True)):
        sig = R24.company_block('DISCLOSER:', 'FLEET TEST CO.', 40) + R24.company_block('RECIPIENT:', 'HARBOR LIGHT ANALYTICS, INC.' if not msa else None, 320)
        if msa: sig = [(r[0], 'CUSTOMER:', False, 320) if r[1] == 'RECIPIENT:' else r for r in sig]
        p1 = list(rc.RECITALS[recital]); pages = [p1, sig]
        if where == 'sig_page_below': pages[1] = sig + struct(cap, nm, tail, 40, 520)
        elif where == 'exhibit_page': pages.append(struct(cap, nm, tail, 40, 300))
        elif where == 'recital_page': pages[0] = p1 + struct(cap, nm, tail, 40, 400)
        else: pages.append(struct(cap, nm, tail, 40, 300) + struct(cap, 'Chris Jones' if nm != 'Chris Jones' else 'Lee Harbor', tail, 320, 300))
        pat = dict(name='Pat Smith', email=rc.PE)
        if signer == 'explicit': pat['company'] = 'Harbor Light Analytics, Inc.'
        people = [TWO[1], pat] if signer == 'both' else [pat]
        k = run(pages, people, dict([(rc.PE, (2, 320, 300, 500)), (rc.DE, (2, 40, 300, 220))]))
        G[(where, k)] += 1
        if k[0] != k[1] or 'W' in k: EX[(k, where, cap, nm, tail)] += 1
print('http', http.call_count, 'model', dict(calls), 'elapsed', round(time.time() - t), 'cells', sum(G.values()))
for x in sorted(G.items(), key=str): print(x)
for key in [lambda k: (k[0], k[1], k[2]), lambda k: (k[0], k[3]), lambda k: (k[0], k[4])]:
    print(sorted(Counter(key(k) for k in EX.elements()).items(), key=str))
